pr_title: Added check for pseudo-headers in trailers
pr_body:
Motivation:
According to the RFC for HTTP2 on Section 8.1.2.1, 'Pseudo-header fields MUST NOT appear in trailers. Endpoints MUST treat a request or response that contains undefined or invalid pseudo-header fields as malformed (Section 8.1.2.6).'

Modifications:
Updated Http2Decoder to check trailers for Pseudo-Headers and treat them as invalid requests according to RFC 7540 Section 8.1.2.6

Result:
After this change, requests with Pseudo-Headers sent inside trailers will be treated as malformed and a stream error is thrown.
Fixes: #13602

issue_context.title: Malformed requests with Pseudo Headers in trailers
issue_context.body:
### Expected behavior
According to RFC 7540 `Pseudo-header fields MUST NOT appear in trailers. Endpoints MUST treat a request or response that contains undefined or invalid pseudo-header fields as malformed (Section 8.1.2.6).` Requests with pseudo-header fields in trailers should be treated as malformed.

### Actual behavior
Pseudo-header on trailers requests are not treated as malformed.

### Steps to reproduce
Send a request with pseudo-headers in trailers.

### Minimal yet complete reproducer code (or URL to code)
Because of using the same headers as trailers, this can be reproduced with the test https://github.com/netty/netty/blob/f1fa227ddf675f055766d04900cce6804fd7f710/codec-http2/src/test/java/io/netty/handler/codec/http2/Http2ConnectionRoundtripTest.java#L1030

### Netty version
4.1.97

### JVM version (e.g. `java -version`)

comments: @natl-set that's a grpc-java issue, which they're fixing.

review_comments:
This change broke users of `grpc-netty`.

https://github.com/grpc/grpc-java/pull/10663

This is clearly a `grpc-netty` bug so there's no action required in Netty - I just wanted to comment here to make the maintainers aware of this issue.

@ejona86 @pkoenig10 The usage of `isEmpty` was fixed in https://github.com/grpc/grpc-java/pull/10663 and #13717, but we did not look closely enough at the problem, because on this line we also call the `iterator()` method on the `Http2Headers`, which `AbstractHttp2Headers` still does not implement: https://github.com/grpc/grpc-java/blob/75492c8b36c9392d94dfce09fc132ce88c94325e/netty/src/main/java/io/grpc/netty/AbstractHttp2Headers.java#L499
I see there's already a grpc-java issue on this: https://github.com/grpc/grpc-java/issues/10837

This looks like it was supposed to be fixed in 1.55.0 with https://github.com/grpc/grpc-java/pull/9979. The report I got was using 1.51.1, and https://github.com/grpc/grpc-java/issues/10837 reports using 1.30.2, so this is probably not an issue for those who are on newer versions!

Oh that's great to hear. I saw the issue this morning as felt, "oh no." Glad it is already added. (Although obviously, better than recently being added would have been "always had been implemented"... We should re-run the benchmarks to see how much of a performance difference it makes to use our own impl, although benchmarking garbage creation is _terribly_ difficult to get meaningful results.)
